svg.text: Microsoft Sentinel (unified Defender portal) on a Log Analytics workspace, eight log sources, deployed with Terraform
Azure VNet, rg-siem-demo (SSH/RDP from admin IP only)
web-01: siem-sim cron every 10 min (web, logins, scans, SSH)
win-01: scheduled task every 30 min (failed logons)
• auth, authpriv, daemon, syslog, local0 > Syslog
Polls API; read-only token held by connector
Web app, SSH, Windows 4625, Entra ID, Okta: one schema (time, source, account, IP)
4 Retention (per table in Terraform: retention_in_days, total_retention_in_days, table plan)
Not used: rules need Nginx data
Queried by search job or restore
Data export to a storage account
Terraform (azurerm, azapi): workspace, Sentinel, custom tables, DCE, DCRs, Activity Log export, retention, analytics rules, workbook, budget
setup-web01.sh: Nginx, Docker, Staff Portal, log rotation, ufw, simulator. setup-win01.ps1 (Run command): audit policy, test account, simulator
Pre-push checks: terraform fmt and validate, gitleaks (history and staged), checkov. Secrets: never in Git; app secrets generated on the host
